[1] Sponsor your spouse, partner or child: Who can sponsor
You can sponsor your spouse, common-law partner, conjugal partner or dependent child if you
- are at least 18 years old
- are a Canadian citizen, a permanent resident of Canada, or a person registered in Canada under the Canadian Indian Act
- live in Canada
- If you’re a Canadian citizen living outside Canada, you must show that you plan to live in Canada when the people you’re sponsoring become permanent residents.
- If you’re a permanent resident living outside Canada, you can’t sponsor.
